title: Romberg, Tandem Gait and Pronator Drift — Three Fast Neuro Screens

hook.en: Three tests, three minutes, three different systems. Learn what each one really tests, how to keep the patient safe and what a "positive" result means.
hook.ur: Teen tests, teen minute, teen mukhtalif systems. Seekhein har ek asal mein kya test karta hai, patient ko mehfooz kaise rakhein aur “positive” result ka kya matlab hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll perform Romberg's test, tandem walking and the pronator drift test safely, and tell what each result says about proprioception, the cerebellum and the corticospinal tract.
goal.ur: End tak aap Romberg test, tandem walking aur pronator drift test mehfooz tareeqay se karenge, aur batayenge ke har result proprioception, cerebellum aur corticospinal tract ke baare mein kya kehta hai.

text.en: Balance and posture rely on three inputs: **vision**, the **vestibular** system and **proprioception** (position sense from joints and muscles), all coordinated by the **cerebellum**. Three quick tests isolate them: **Romberg** removes vision, **tandem gait** narrows the base so the cerebellum must work hard, and **pronator drift** tests whether the **corticospinal tract** can hold an arm position.
text.ur: Balance aur posture teen inputs par depend karte hain: **vision**, **vestibular** system aur **proprioception** (joints aur muscles se position sense), jinhein **cerebellum** coordinate karta hai. Teen tez tests inhein alag karte hain: **Romberg** vision hata deta hai, **tandem gait** base ko tang kar ke cerebellum ko zyada kaam karne par majboor karti hai, aur **pronator drift** parkhta hai ke **corticospinal tract** arm ki position pakar sakta hai ya nahi.

text.en: Standing with eyes closed is like removing one of the three legs of a stool. If the other two are healthy, you stay up. If one of them (proprioception) was already weak and vision was doing the work, the stool tips as soon as vision goes. That tip is a positive Romberg.
text.ur: Aankhein band kar ke khara hona stool ki teen taangon mein se ek hata dene jaisa hai. Agar baqi do theek hon to aap khare rehte hain. Agar ek (proprioception) pehle se kamzor thi aur vision kaam chala rahi thi, to vision jate hi stool gir jata hai. Yeh girna positive Romberg hai.

intro.en: Feet together, arms by the sides. Choose **Eyes: Open**, then **Closed (normal)**, then **Closed (positive Romberg)** and compare the sway. Note how the examiner stands close, ready to catch.
intro.ur: Pair saath, arms side mein. **Eyes: Open**, phir **Closed (normal)**, phir **Closed (positive Romberg)** chunein aur sway compare karein. Dekhein ke examiner qareeb khara hai, girne se pakarne ke liye tayyar.

question.en: A patient is steady with eyes open but sways and steps within seconds of closing his eyes. What is the most likely cause?
question.ur: Patient aankhein khuli hon to steady hai lekin aankhein band karne ke chand seconds mein jhoomta aur qadam uthata hai. Sab se mumkin wajah?

text.en: Loss of proprioception (e.g. peripheral neuropathy or dorsal column disease)
text.ur: Proprioception ki kami (maslan peripheral neuropathy ya dorsal column disease)

feedback.en: Yes — vision was compensating for lost position sense; this is a classic positive Romberg.
feedback.ur: Haan — vision position sense ki kami ko compensate kar rahi thi; yeh classic positive Romberg hai.

feedback.en: Cerebellar patients are unsteady even with the eyes open, so Romberg is not "positive" in the classic sense.
feedback.ur: Cerebellar patients aankhein khuli hon tab bhi unsteady hotay hain, is liye Romberg classic maani mein “positive” nahi.

feedback.en: Normal patients show only slight sway with eyes closed.
feedback.ur: Normal patients aankhein band karne par sirf halka sa sway dikhate hain.

intro.en: The patient walks along a straight line, one foot directly in front of the other. Use the **Patient** option to compare "Healthy" with "Cerebellar lesion": wide-based, lurching, constant side-to-side correction (**truncal ataxia**).
intro.ur: Patient seedhi line par chalta hai, ek pair bilkul doosray ke aage. **Patient** option se “Healthy” ko “Cerebellar lesion” se compare karein: wide-based, ladkhadati, musalsal side-to-side correction (**truncal ataxia**).

intro.en: Both arms out in front, palms up, eyes closed, for 20–30 seconds. Use the **Arm** option to compare "Normal" with "Drift (pyramidal weakness)": one forearm slowly turns palm-down and the arm sinks.
intro.ur: Dono arms aage, palms upar, aankhein band, 20–30 seconds. **Arm** option se “Normal” ko “Drift (pyramidal kamzori)” se compare karein: ek forearm aahista palm-down ho jata hai aur arm neeche girta hai.

title.ur: Har screen kya test karta hai

rows.ur: Proprioception, jab vision hata di jaye

rows.en: Dorsal column, peripheral neuropathy, B12 deficiency or a vestibular lesion
rows.ur: Dorsal column, peripheral neuropathy, B12 ki kami ya vestibular lesion

rows.en: The cerebellum, with a narrowed base of support
rows.ur: Cerebellum, tang base of support ke saath

rows.en: Cerebellar or vestibular disease; also reduced by age and fatigue
rows.ur: Cerebellar ya vestibular bimari; umar aur thakan se bhi kam hoti hai

rows.en: Upper motor neuron weakness (pronation and sinking); cerebellar and parietal lesions drift without pronation
rows.ur: Upper motor neuron kamzori (pronation aur dhalna); cerebellar aur parietal lesions pronation ke bagair drift karti hain

text.en: **Unsafe testing.** Romberg and tandem walking can topple an unsteady patient. Stand close, one hand ready near the shoulder (or use a gait belt), and test beside a wall or bed. Stop if the patient sways more than a step. Another trap: calling the test "positive" when the patient is unsteady even with eyes open. That is not Romberg; look at the cerebellum or vestibular system instead.
text.ur: **Gair mehfooz testing.** Romberg aur tandem walking unsteady patient ko gira sakti hain. Qareeb khare hon, ek haath shoulder ke qareeb tayyar (ya gait belt), aur deewar ya bed ke saath test karein. Agar patient ek qadam se zyada jhoome to ruk jayein. Ek aur jaal: aankhein khuli hone par bhi unsteady patient mein test ko “positive” kehna. Yeh Romberg nahi; cerebellum ya vestibular system dekhein.

question.en: In the pronator drift test, the left forearm slowly turns palm-down and sinks. What does it point to?
question.ur: Pronator drift test mein left forearm aahista palm-down ho kar neeche dhalta hai. Yeh kis ki taraf ishara karta hai?

text.en: A subtle upper motor neuron (pyramidal) lesion on the right side of the brain
text.ur: Dimagh ki right side mein halki upper motor neuron (pyramidal) lesion

feedback.en: Yes — pronation plus sinking is the classic pyramidal drift; the contralateral hemisphere is affected.
feedback.ur: Haan — pronation aur dhalna classic pyramidal drift hai; contralateral hemisphere affected hota hai.

feedback.en: Cerebellar drift tends to rise, wander or overshoot without pronation.
feedback.ur: Cerebellar drift upar uthta, bhatakta ya overshoot karta hai, pronation ke bagair.

feedback.en: Neuropathy does not cause this posture drift.
feedback.ur: Neuropathy yeh posture drift nahi karti.

text.en: **Use them as a screening triad.** In a few minutes you have checked proprioception (Romberg), cerebellar function (tandem) and pyramidal function (pronator drift). Record the result precisely: "Romberg positive: steps within 10 s with eyes closed; tandem unable beyond 2 steps; no pronator drift". A positive finding does not name the diagnosis; it tells you which system to examine next and who to refer.
text.ur: **Inhein screening triad ki tarah use karein.** Chand minutes mein aap ne proprioception (Romberg), cerebellar function (tandem) aur pyramidal function (pronator drift) check kar liye. Result sahi likhein: “Romberg positive: aankhein band karne ke 10 s ke andar qadam uthaya; tandem 2 qadam se aage nahi; pronator drift nahi”. Positive finding tashkhees ka naam nahi batati; yeh batati hai ke agla kaun sa system dekhna hai aur kis ko refer karna hai.

text.en: Romberg is **not a sensitive test of balance** and its interpretation varies between clinicians, but a clearly positive result is specific for a proprioceptive or vestibular problem. Tandem gait speed and the number of steps completed are among the earliest changes in cerebellar disease and in older adults at risk of falls. Pronator drift is a **sensitive** sign of a mild corticospinal lesion and is more reliable when the patient holds the position with eyes closed.
text.ur: Romberg balance ka **sensitive test nahi** hai aur iski interpretation clinicians mein mukhtalif hoti hai, lekin wazeh positive result proprioceptive ya vestibular masle ke liye specific hai. Tandem gait ki speed aur poore kiye gaye qadamon ki ginti cerebellar bimari aur girne ke khatre wale buzurgon mein sab se pehli tabdeeliyon mein se hain. Pronator drift halki corticospinal lesion ka **sensitive** sign hai aur aankhein band karke position pakarne par zyada reliable hai.

question.en: Why do we ask the patient to close the eyes for the pronator drift test?
question.ur: Pronator drift test mein patient se aankhein band karne ko kyun kehte hain?

answer.en: Because vision lets the patient correct the arm position, hiding a subtle drift. With the eyes closed the arm has to be held by **proprioception and corticospinal control** alone.
answer.ur: Kyunke vision patient ko arm ki position durust karne deti hai aur halka drift chhup jata hai. Aankhein band hon to arm ko sirf **proprioception aur corticospinal control** se pakarna parta hai.

question.en: Which test narrows the base of support so the cerebellum must work hard?
question.ur: Kaun sa test base of support ko tang karta hai taake cerebellum ko zyada kaam karna pare?

feedback.en: Yes — walking heel-to-toe is the most sensitive bedside test for mild cerebellar disease.
feedback.ur: Haan — heel-to-toe chalna halki cerebellar bimari ke liye sab se sensitive bedside test hai.

feedback.en: Romberg removes vision; it does not narrow the base further.
feedback.ur: Romberg vision hata deta hai; base ko mazeed tang nahi karta.

feedback.en: Pronator drift tests arm posture, not gait.
feedback.ur: Pronator drift arm posture test karta hai, gait nahi.

text.en: **Refer urgently** if any of these screens is newly positive together with a sudden onset, severe headache, speech or vision change, facial droop or one-sided weakness (think stroke: use BE-FAST), or if the patient is too unsteady to be tested safely. Do not test a patient with acute dizziness or a suspected cervical spine injury by making them stand unsupported.
text.ur: **Foran refer karein** agar in screens mein se koi nayi positive ho aur saath achanak shuruaat, shadeed sir dard, bolne ya nazar mein tabdeeli, chehre ka latakna ya ek taraf ki kamzori ho (stroke sochein: BE-FAST), ya patient itna unsteady ho ke mehfooz test na ho sake. Acute chakkar ya shak-e-cervical spine injury wale patient ko bina sahare khara kar ke test na karein.

summary.en: Romberg tests proprioception (vision removed), tandem gait tests the cerebellum, pronator drift tests the corticospinal tract.
summary.ur: Romberg proprioception (vision hata kar), tandem gait cerebellum, pronator drift corticospinal tract test karta hai.

summary.en: Keep the patient safe (close, wall, gait belt) and call Romberg positive only if steady with eyes open and unsteady with eyes closed.
summary.ur: Patient ko mehfooz rakhein (qareeb, deewar, gait belt) aur Romberg tab positive kahein jab aankhein khuli hon to steady aur band hon to unsteady.

summary.en: A positive screen tells you which system to examine next; sudden onset with headache, speech or weakness changes needs urgent referral.
summary.ur: Positive screen batati hai ke agla kaun sa system dekhna hai; achanak shuruaat, sir dard, bolne ya kamzori mein tabdeeli urgent refer chahiye.

front.ur: Romberg test kab positive hota hai?

back.en: When the patient is steady with eyes open but loses balance with eyes closed (proprioceptive or vestibular loss).
back.ur: Jab patient aankhein khuli hon to steady aur band hon to balance kho de (proprioceptive ya vestibular kami).

back.en: A subtle corticospinal (upper motor neuron) lesion: the forearm pronates and the arm sinks.
back.ur: Halki corticospinal (upper motor neuron) lesion: forearm pronate hoti hai aur arm dhalta hai.

front.en: Which test is the most sensitive bedside test of mild cerebellar disease?
front.ur: Halki cerebellar bimari ka sab se sensitive bedside test?
Aankhein band kar ke test kyun karte hain?

back.en: Vision hides proprioceptive and corticospinal deficits; closing the eyes forces the patient to rely on position sense.
back.ur: Vision proprioceptive aur corticospinal kami ko chhupati hai; aankhein band karne se patient ko position sense par bharosa karna parta hai.
